stories.title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
stories.brief: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

stories.title: Lawyer says Shah Mahmood Qureshi taken to hospital days after suffering fall
stories.brief: LAHORE: The lawyer representing Shah Mahmood Qureshi said on Tuesday that the senior PTI leader, who is currently incarcerated at Kot Lakhpat jail, was taken to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology (PIC) days after suffering a fall.

stories.title: Shah Mahmood rushed to Punjab Institute of Cardiology after reported prison collapse
stories.brief: Senior PTI leader Shah Mahmood Qureshi was on Tuesday transferred to Lahore's Punjab Institute of Cardiology (PIC) after reportedly collapsing inside Kot Lakhpat jail, prompting his family to seek urgent medical investigations and treatment. I learnt of my father Shah Mahmood Qureshi's fall from family after they met him in Kot Lakhpat jail today.

stories.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
stories.brief: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.

stories.title: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
stories.brief: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

stories.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.brief: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.

stories.title: The swan sanctuary wetland fighting climate change
stories.brief: The global campaign to restore the "soggy secret weapon" that can combat against climate change.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Turkiye to address COP31 summit
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Antalya, Turkiye, on Tuesday for a three-day visit to attend the Leaders’ Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties (COP 31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

stories.title: Israel's parliament sworn in as Eisenkot tries to forge a government
stories.brief: Israel’s parliament was sworn in on Tuesday without a new government, after a deadlocked general election stripped Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his parliamentary majority but left his main rivals with no clear path to power.

stories.title: ‘Hatred should come to an end’: Gohar defends interaction with ex-army chief Bajwa amid criticism
stories.brief: PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Tuesday defended his brief interaction with former army chief Gen Qamar Javed Bajwa, saying political hostilities should end, and clarified that the two had merely exchanged greetings at a wedding.

stories.title: NAB issues second notice to JUI-F chief's son over alleged 'illegal appointments' in Pakistan Post
stories.brief: NAB officials declared his response unsatisfactory and issued a fresh notice, directing him to appear in person at 11am on Friday. NAB had earlier summoned Rehman's son on November 5 over alleged irregularities in the appointments at the PPOD during his tenure.

stories.title: Uzma moves SC for early hearing of Imran's medical transfer case
stories.brief: Read: PTI seeks Imran's immediate transfer to Shifa International Hospital over renewed blood pressure concern Uzma had already filed a contempt petition against the prime minister and other executive authorities over their alleged failure to implement the August 18 order.

stories.title: 13 Pakistanis dead in Greek detention since 2000: report
stories.brief: The report said that at least 112 foreign nationals in total had died in police and immigration detention facilities in Greece since 2000, with authorities failing to maintain a reliable public record of the deaths.

stories.title: Pakistan, US seek closer academic and think tank exchanges
stories.brief: Read: Trump nominates Natalie Baker as next US ambassador to Pakistan Her nomination is subject to confirmation by the US Senate. This shift was largely driven by a major reset in relations following President Trump's intervention in regional conflicts, particularly his role in brokering a ceasefire between Pakistan and India in May 2025.

stories.title: £190m corruption case: IHC adjourns hearing for 10 days, orders meeting between Imran and legal team
stories.brief: Justice Dogar observed that Khosa would argue the main appeals and directed the advocate general to facilitate his meeting with Imran.

stories.title: Tariq Fazal defends Imran's medical treatment amid renewed concerns
stories.brief: Speaking to reporters at the Parliament House, Chaudhry said that Barrister Salman Safdar had himself acknowledged that medical check-up facilities were "available" to Imran during a media talk outside Islamabad High Court earlier in the day.

stories.title: IHC orders one-hour jail meeting for Imran Khan, Bushra Bibi with lawyers
stories.brief: In April 2026, Barrister Salman Safdar met Imran for a 60-minute legal consultation on the IHC’s orders, but Bushra Bibi was not brought in to join the meeting.

stories.title: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment motion
stories.brief: Republicans have blocked a motion to impeach US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth over the war on Iran.

stories.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
stories.brief: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

stories.title: Duchy tenants may have to buy farms or leave as Prince William plans sell-off
stories.brief: A ten-year strategy to raise £500m from the Duchy of Cornwall will see farms sold off across England.
